Pressure rating will be based on ASTM D 2992 or other industry accepted codes and standards subject to Aker Kvaerner Chemetics approval.  Where requested, Vendor will submit dimensional
standards with design calculations and/or proof of design test results.  Pipe and fitting pressure ratings will be based on a service design factor of 0.5 or less applied to the static Hydrostatic
Design Basis (HDB), and 1.0 or less applied to the cyclic HDB established in accordance with ASTM D 2992.  Where an HDB has not been established, the pressure rating for straight pipe may
be based on a safety factor of 10:1 applied to the short-term hoop strength.  Minimum structural layer thickness will be 5mm.
Vinylester resins DERAKANE® 411, HETRON® 922, Palatal® A-430 or Aker Kvaerner Chemetics approved equivalent will be used for the corrosion liner/anti-wicking barrier and structural layer.
For the exterior layer (final 1.5mm) use DERAKANE® 510C, HETRON® FR 992  or Aker Kvaerner Chemetics approved equivalent with 5% antimony trioxide added to achieve an ASTM E 84
Class 1 flame spread rating.  The exterior surface resin will contain a pigment [colour TBD], UV inhibitor and external wax/resin top coat (i.e. hot coat).  Curing system to be MEKP/CoNap.
Corrosion liner/anti-wicking barrier: 3mm minimum thickness, 1 Nexus veil + 3 layers chopped strand mat (CSM), HLU construction, excluded from structural calculations.  Exterior surface layer:
Finish with 1 layer CSM + C-glass veil and exterior resin coats, excluded from structural calculations.
One piece molded fittings with integral structure are preferred.  Fittings and branch connections made by intersecting (corrosion lined) pipes and overlapping the seam area with an additional
corrosion liner are acceptable where the internal overlay is accessible.  Smooth flow elbows will be supplied for sizes DN750 and less, 2 or 3 piece mitered elbows may be used for sizes DN900
Flanged branches smaller than DN100 will have 4 equally spaced gussets.
Butt & strap joints will be 6:1 tapered type.  The exposed width of corrosion liner will be less than the liner thickness.
Where requested, the Vendor will provide pre-cut field joint kits and detailed field joint installation drawings and instructions.  Joint kits will be supplied in individual water tight packages.
Only sheet glass goods and continuous roving from approved manufacturers will be used.  Chopper-spray guns are not permitted.
When connecting to raised face flanges, use an FRP vanstone stub-end with a steel back up ring and IBC style gasket.
Where butterfly valves or check valves are installed, the piping designer will check to ensure the valve disc does not foul the flange bore.
